text:
lee: FYI — noticed invoice-preview for a handful of tenants briefly dropped token counts around 07:14 UTC. Looks tied to route rebinding during SKU rollout. preview panel showed 0 then back to normal a minute later.

anika: tenant sampled: beta-retail, trace=`tr-91c3`. logs show route rebind + heartbeat gap:
```
2025-01-08T07:13:59Z INFO route-resolver bind sku=beta-eu -> route:r7
2025-01-08T07:14:00Z WARN quota-heartbeat ttl_expired tenant=beta-retail window=30s
2025-01-08T07:14:01Z INFO metering-event emitted tokens=58 route=r7 fingerprint=fp-x1y2
```

ross: my read: dedupe uses `tenant|fingerprint|route_resolution_id` so when route_resolution_id flips mid-session the preview dedupe treats it as a new event then aggregation briefly shows zero due to ordering.

lee: can confirm — fingerprint stayed identical, route changed from r6->r7. dedupe key is causing the preview blip.

pm-nora: product wants per-SKU cost breakdown in preview. Can't just drop route from dedupe key without losing per-route visibility.

anika: idea: introduce ephemeral alias mapping at ingest that ties successive route_resolution_ids within same session to a canonical_preview_route for a short window (90s). dedupe for preview uses canonical_preview_route, while billing retains strict route_resolution_id.

ross: sounds reasonable. required changes: ingest mapping table, short TTL, backfill-safe, add a flag `preview_mode=true` on the tally path. Also update console to annotate when canonicalization applied.

metric-bot: CHART: heartbeat-jitter spike 07:12-07:16 (link: http://dash/heartbeat?from=07:00&to=08:00)

qa-bot: note: add unit + integration tests for session route flips + ensure no cross-tenant aliasing.

lee: risk: if we alias too aggressively we might merge genuine retries across route variants and undercount duplicate protection. Proposal: only alias when events are within same session_id and fingerprint unchanged, and only for preview window.

pm-nora: +1 for preview-only solution. Also request a console tooltip "Preview may canonicalize route for short windows; billing unaffected".

anika: I'll draft the PR for ingest aliasing + tests. Ross can own insertion into tally path and the preview flag. Metric-bot will surface `preview_alias_count` metric and a per-tenant series.

ross: plan: canary to 2% tenants, watch `preview_alias_count` and invoice-preview-diff. If diff reduces and no regressions, roll to 25% then global.

lee: ops note: this likely mitigates the support ticket volume. Would still like a follow-up to audit other dedupe keys that include volatile routing metadata.

anika: logging: will emit `preview_alias` event with keys: tenant, fingerprint, canonical_route, observed_route, session_id.

pm-nora: timeline: can we get canary tomorrow morning PST? Product wants to communicate to early access teams.

lee: thanks everyone. I'll open a support brief and add console annotation copy for PM review.
